# Instron Technologies

> Instron Technologies engineers and builds integrated process systems for technology developers and industrial
> manufacturers, from pilot and demonstration plants to industrial skids, with the automation and plant data to run them.
> Engineering since 2013. Independent company, not affiliated with Instron® (ITW).

## Solutions
- [Process Skid Plants](https://www.instrontechnologies.com/process-skid-plants.html): pilot and demonstration plants and modular industrial process skids. Our core solution.
- [Industrial Automation & Controls](https://www.instrontechnologies.com/industrial-automation.html): E&I design, PLC, HMI and SCADA engineering, control panels and S88 batch control. Delivered with our skids or on its own.
- [PlantON™ by Instron Technologies](https://www.instrontechnologies.com/planton-digital-factory.html): plant data platform for traceability, OEE, compliance reports and production views, without replacing existing controls.
- [How We Work](https://www.instrontechnologies.com/how-we-work.html): Basic Engineering & Feasibility, Detailed Engineering, and Integrated Design & Build, each contracted separately.
